name: Aerie — Electric Air Taxi
description: A cream-and-electric-blue site for Aerie, an invented all-electric air taxi: Manrope set huge and tight on a golden-ratio scale, soft warm shadows and dusk photography. The home page is one long pinned scroll story — a rounded hero card opens to the whole window, the cabin, the wing and an original tilt-rotor drawing lift past under changing captions, then the picture lifts like a lid and the sky turns to paper. Under it: a highlights gallery with drifting thumbnails, a manifesto that inks itself in word by word, a working glass app laid over a photograph (pick pads and a time, press and hold to book), a pinned weekday that re-plans itself as you scroll, a dusk engineering band, notes, and a blue 'dream of flight' close with climbing clouds. The menu opens as a curtain of horizon stripes. Plus Experience (a pinned five-screen phone journey, a seat map, a real booking flow and fares), Aircraft (rotors that tilt on scroll, a noise slider, anatomy hotspots, a motor-failure grid, a charge-day chart), Routes (a live network map with quotes, a pinned time-back counter, the sticky partners list, careers and a waitlist) and a live brand guide.
designedFor: Mobility, aviation, travel and hardware launch sites
Story-led landing pages built around one long scroll-pinned, scroll-scrubbed opening
Brands that want loud oversized type on a warm, quiet surface with one electric accent
Seeing working SVG mockups — a booking app, a route map, an aircraft — built as editor-controllable components
